title: Pac-Gal © 1982 J. Jimenez - PC DOS - Gameplay
method: Download audio from YouTube, convert to mono 48 kHz; calculate 10 ms RMS and detect movement-effect peaks (threshold 0.14, min prominence 0.025, min spacing 80 ms).
inference: One repeated game sound event coincides with each player turn in these sections; timing remains approximate from compressed video audio.
ghosts: The source updates all four ghosts once in each player turn; a ghost-eat animation pauses gameplay for about 165 ms.
